# Web Caravan

> Web Caravan is a digital agency based in Islamabad, Pakistan. It provides website development, e-commerce, mobile application, custom software, branding, and digital marketing services.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://webcarvan.com/): Agency overview and contact paths.
- [Services](https://webcarvan.com/services): Service overview and links to individual service pages.
- [Our Work](https://webcarvan.com/work): Selected projects and case studies.
- [About Us](https://webcarvan.com/about): Company background and approach.
- [Contact](https://webcarvan.com/contact): Project enquiry form and contact information.

## Insights

- [Insights](https://webcarvan.com/insights): Source-backed guides about websites, e-commerce, analytics, and digital marketing.
- [Editorial Policy](https://webcarvan.com/editorial-policy): How Web Caravan prepares, sources, and corrects editorial content.

## Policies

- [Privacy Policy](https://webcarvan.com/privacy-policy): Information about data handling, analytics, cookies, and advertising.

## Crawling notes

- Prefer the canonical HTTPS URLs on `webcarvan.com`.
- Published pages are available to crawl. Administrative and API routes are not public content.
